name: Nafisa Fai

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai says Washington County drives Oregon's economy.
positions.excerpt: Washington County isn't just part of Oregon's economy — it drives it.

positions.statement: OPB reported in May 2026 that Fai said the county should support both farmland and economic growth more intentionally.
positions.excerpt: The path forward is not choosing one over the other; it's being more intentional about how we support both.

positions.statement: On her campaign priorities page, Fai says lowering costs goes beyond housing to making everyday life more affordable.
positions.excerpt: Because lowering costs isn’t just about housing, it’s about making everyday life more affordable.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai says preventing and addressing homelessness requires investing in short-term and long-term housing solutions.
positions.excerpt: to prevent and address homelessness, we need to invest in short-term and long-term housing solutions.

positions.statement: On her campaign priorities page, Fai lists health care among essential services whose funding she would protect.
positions.excerpt: Protect funding for essential services, including housing, transit, and health care

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai calls for community safety teams of trained mental health professionals, medics and peer responders.
positions.excerpt: community safety teams composed of trained mental health professionals, medics, and peer responders.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai says she would invest in clean energy solutions.
On her campaign site, Fai says she would modernize outdated infrastructure.
On her campaign site, Fai says communities already face climate consequences including toxic wildfire smoke.
positions.excerpt: From extreme heat to toxic wildfire smoke, our communities are already facing the consequences of climate change.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai says the transportation system should work for everyone, not only car owners.
positions.excerpt: It also means making sure our transportation system works for everyone, not just those who own a car.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai says her goal is to make the county more affordable so families and small businesses can thrive.
positions.excerpt: Nafisa’s goal is to make Washington County more affordable, to help every person, family, and small business thrive.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Fai lists creating good-paying green jobs and expanding workforce training programs.
positions.excerpt: creating good paying, green jobs; and expanding workforce training programs.
